notes: Smartphone IMU HAR dataset (often called the 'Shoaib SA'/2014 activity dataset). 10 male participants; 7 activities: walking, sitting, standing, jogging, biking, walking upstairs, walking downstairs (each performed 3-4 min, done simultaneously at all body positions). 5 on-body phone positions collected simultaneously: right jeans pocket, left jeans pocket, belt (right side via belt clip), right upper arm, right wrist. Device: Samsung Galaxy SII (i9100). Sensors logged: 3-axis accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer (plus linear acceleration). Sampling rate 50 Hz (50 samples/s). Paper uses a 2-second sliding window for feature extraction. Data hosted on the University of Twente Pervasive Systems (PS) group dataset page; a related follow-up dataset (complex activities, 2016) is on the same page as 'sensors-activity-recognition-dataset-shoaib.rar'.
